SELECT 
    sc.Charter,
    sc.GSserved,
    CASE 
        WHEN (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) BETWEEN 1200 AND 1500 THEN 'Average'
        WHEN (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) > 1500 THEN 'Above Average'
        ELSE 'No SAT Data'
    END AS SAT_Performance_Level,
    (f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) - county_avg.avg_free_rate AS deviation_from_county_avg
FROM schools sc
JOIN frpm f ON sc.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT AVG(f2.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS avg_free_rate
    FROM frpm f2
    JOIN schools sc2 ON f2.CDSCode = sc2.CDSCode
    WHERE sc2.County = 'Alameda'
) county_avg
WHERE sc.County = 'Alameda'
ORDER BY (f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.Charter,
    s.GSserved,
    CASE 
        WHEN sa.AvgScrRead IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) BETWEEN 1200 AND 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS SAT_Performance_Level,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` - county_avg.avg_free_rate AS deviation_from_county_avg
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON f.CDSCode = sa.cds
JOIN (
    SELECT AVG(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) AS avg_free_rate
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `County Name` = 'Alameda'
) county_avg ON 1=1
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Alameda'
ORDER BY f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

    (f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) - county_avg.avg_free_meal_rate AS Deviation_From_County_Avg
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools sc ON f.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT AVG(f2.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS avg_free_meal_rate
    FROM frpm f2
    JOIN schools sc2 ON f2.CDSCode = sc2.CDSCode
    WHERE sc2.County = 'Alameda'
) county_avg
WHERE sc.County = 'Alameda'
ORDER BY (f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

    s.Charter,
    s.GSserved,
    CASE 
        WHEN sa.NumTstTakr IS NULL OR sa.NumTstTakr = 0 THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) BETWEEN 1200 AND 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS SAT_Performance_Level,

ORDER BY `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` ASC

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `School Name` IN (
    SELECT `School` FROM schools WHERE `SOCType` = 'Continuation High Schools'
)
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `School Type` = 'Continuation High Schools'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / NULLIF(`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`, 0) AS eligible_free_rate_5_17
FROM frpm
WHERE `School Name` IN (
    SELECT School FROM schools WHERE SOCType = 'Continuation High Schools'
)
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate_5_17 ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `School Type` = 'Continuation High Schools'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOCType = 'Continuation High Schools'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOCType = 'Continuation High Schools'
  AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`,
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`,
    sat.NumTstTakr,
    sat.AvgScrRead,
    sat.AvgScrMath,
    sat.AvgScrWrite,
    sat.NumGE1500,
    (CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NULLIF(sat.NumTstTakr, 0)) AS ExcellenceRate,
    s.OpenDate,
    s.StatusType,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 0.75 THEN 'High FRPM'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` BETWEEN 0.50 AND 0.75 THEN 'Medium FRPM'
        ELSE 'Low FRPM'
    END AS FRPM_Category
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
  AND f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1;

debug_candidates.raw_response:
SELECT s.CDSCode,
       s.School,
       sname,
       AvgScrMath,
       AvgScrRead,
       AvgScrWrite,
       (AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS total_sat,
       enroll12,
       NumTstTakr,
       NumGE1500,
       (NumGE1500 * 1.0 / NumTstTakr) AS excellence_rate,
       `Enrollment (K-12)`,
       `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
  AND sc.AvgScrMath > 400
ORDER BY total_sat DESC;

WITH school_data AS (
  SELECT 
    s.County,
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
    f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`,
    (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS total_enrollment,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS frpm_pct,
    f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)`,
    f.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS charter_status,
    sat.NumTstTakr,
    sat.AvgScrRead,
    sat.AvgScrMath,
    sat.AvgScrWrite,
    (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) AS total_sat,
    sat.NumGE1500,
    (sat.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sat.NumTstTakr) AS excellence_rate,
    CASE 
      WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 0.75 THEN 'High'
      WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 0.50 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
    END AS frpm_category
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
  WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 500
    AND (f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 0.60 OR (sat.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sat.NumTstTakr) > 0.30)
)
SELECT 
  County,
  School,
  total_enrollment,
  `Enrollment (K-12)`,
  `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`,
  `Free Meal Count (K-12)`,
  frpm_pct,
  charter_status,
  NumTstTakr,
  AvgScrRead,
  AvgScrMath,
  AvgScrWrite,
  total_sat,
  NumGE1500,
  excellence_rate,
  frpm_category,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY County ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC) AS enrollment_rank,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY County, CASE 
    WHEN frpm_pct >= 0.75 THEN 'High'
    WHEN frpm_pct >= 0.50 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END ORDER BY total_sat DESC) AS sat_rank
FROM school_data
ORDER BY County, enrollment_rank, frpm_category, sat_rank;

SELECT s.School, s.Phone, s.City, s.Charter,
       CASE 
           WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 0.75 THEN 'High Poverty'
           WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 0.50 THEN 'Medium Poverty'
           WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 0.25 THEN 'Low Poverty'
           ELSE 'Very Low Poverty'
       END AS poverty_classification,
       (sa.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sa.NumTstTakr) AS excellence_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE sa.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY excellence_rate DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.School, s.Phone, s.City, 
       CASE WHEN s.Charter = 1 THEN 'Charter' ELSE 'Non-Charter' END AS CharterStatus,
       CASE 
           WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 0.75 THEN 'High Poverty'

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN s.NumTstTakr < 50 THEN 'under 50 testers'
        WHEN s.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN '50-100 testers'
        WHEN s.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 101 AND 250 THEN '100-250 testers'
    END AS testing_volume_category,
    AVG(s.AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading_score,
    AVG(s.AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score,
    AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score,
    AVG(s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr) AS avg_excellence_rate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.cds) AS school_count,
    AVG(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS avg_enrollment,
    AVG(f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`) AS avg_frpm_percent
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
JOIN frpm f ON sch.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE sch.County = 'Fresno'
  AND f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'
  AND s.NumTstTakr <= 250
GROUP BY testing_volume_category;

SELECT 
    AVG(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` * 100) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.Charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_count,
    AVG(sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_total,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 600 THEN 'Very High'
        WHEN f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Moderate'

  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
GROUP BY free_meal_category;

SELECT 
    sc.School,
    fr.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS FRPM_Count,
    fr.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Enrollment,
    fr.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS FRPM_Rate,
    sa.NumTstTakr,
    sa.enroll12,
    CAST(sa.NumTstTakr AS REAL) / sa.enroll12 AS SAT_Participation_Rate,
    sa.NumGE1500,
    CAST(sa.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sa.NumTstTakr AS High_Scorer_Rate
FROM schools sc
JOIN frpm fr ON sc.CDSCode = fr.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON sc.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sc.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY fr.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    sc.School,
    fr.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
    fr.`FRPM Count (K-12)`,
    (fr.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / fr.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS `Eligibility Rate`,
    sa.NumTstTakr,
    sa.enroll12,
    (sa.NumTstTakr * 1.0 / sa.enroll12) AS `SAT Participation Rate`,
    sa.NumGE1500,
    (sa.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sa.NumTstTakr) AS `High Scorer Rate`,
    sa.AvgScrRead,
    sa.AvgScrMath,
    sa.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools sc
JOIN frpm fr ON sc.CDSCode = fr.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON sc.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sc.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY fr.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    s.sname AS School_Name,
    sa.AvgScrRead AS Avg_Reading_Score,
    sa.AvgScrMath AS Avg_Math_Score,
    sa.AvgScrWrite AS Avg_Writing_Score,
    (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) AS Total_SAT_Score,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS Overall_Rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC) AS Reading_Rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.AvgScrMath DESC) AS Math_Rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS Writing_Rank,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS FRPM_Eligibility_Rate,
    (sa.NumTstTakr * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS Test_Participation_Rate,
    sa.AvgScrWrite - AVG(sa2.AvgScrWrite) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.dname) AS Writing_Score_vs_District_Avg
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sa2 ON sa.dname = sa2.dname AND sa2.rtype = 'D'
WHERE (s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich' AND s.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci')
   OR (s.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich' AND s.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci')
   OR (s.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich' AND s.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci');
